_about: Voiceover lines for the hero video. voice.py renders a few takes of each line ('say' is the spelling the model is given, 'seeds' fixes a take); 'take' is the one used, checked with Whisper, and 'at' is when its speech begins, in seconds of the video (audio.py trims the take's lead-in and places it there). Counts are said roundly so the narration stays true as the ledger grows.

lines.text: Cyphersolver is an open ledger of historical ciphers: what was deciphered, by whom, and how.
lines.say: Cypher Solver is an open ledger of historical ciphers: what was deciphered, by whom, and how.

lines.text: How far can an AI, working with a human, get on ciphers that have beaten people for centuries?
Find the letter. Transcribe every sign. Recover the key. And write it all up.
Here is one line from fifteen thirty-three.
He is to be spoken with in the morning... when he is sober.
Over five hundred entries, across six centuries.
Well over a hundred keys recovered. Every attempt is recorded, failures too, for a study with George Lasry on how AI performs.
lines.say: Well over a hundred keys recovered. Every attempt is recorded, failures too, for a study with George Lasri on how AI performs.

lines.text: Anyone can add to the ledger: a solution, a fuller reading, a new cipher, or a check of one already here.
Open an issue, send a pull request, or just email.
Every contribution is credited, by name.
Pick a cipher. Break it. Write it up.
